description: Score < 30 ALLOW, 30-69 REVIEW, >= 70 BLOCK. Owned by decision-service and deliberately separate from the ruleset owned by scoring-service, so an auditor reviewing a historical decision can tell whether the model changed or the policy changed (ADR-0008). Invariant enforced on load: 0 <= allowBelow <= blockAtOrAbove <= 100 - an inverted policy makes BLOCK unreachable and silently allows everything.
